title: Fixed Slotted Indexing Display
description: One new complete fixed slotted-indexing layout display. A single thick four-arm wheel contains four genuine open-ended parallel-sided radial slots and continuous concave inter-arm locking bays. A separate offset rear driver disc carries one whole fixed projecting peg into the right-hand slot. Its interrupted annular locking shoulder is on the opposite side, clear in this frozen pin-entry pose. Two complete parallel shafts, four bored bearing pedestals and one grounded bed support the apparatus. All numeric geometry newly authored: not old spur gears with fewer teeth, a planetary carrier rearrangement or a vertical cam/tappet stamp machine. The wheel centre is solid and fixed into its hub rather than claimed an open through-bore. Three opaque constant PBR roles, closed editable components, metres, Z up and whole horizontal ground-centred datum. One static prop, zero scenes. Peg clearances and lock-sector placement show this pose only; no completed indexing trajectory, dwell law, Geneva kinematic accuracy, continuous engagement, drive, rotation, transmission ratio, torque, manufacture, loading or machinery safety claim.
